I0(2 sqrt z) = (1/2pi i) oint exp(x + z/x) dx/x  -- the Borel kernel is an EXPONENTIAL PERIOD (classical contour integral).

kappa = coefficient of (1-3z)^{-4/3} in Phi at z=1/3 = Stokes datum = discontinuity amplitude across the singular ray = Gamma(4/3) A0.
